//Kestrel: Bound to 0.0.0.0, NOT localhost: the sandbox container dials back via host.docker.internal, which resolves to the host bridge gateway — a listener on 127.0.0.1 is unreachable from inside the container and the runner never enrols ("Connection refused", container exits 1).
//Sandbox: ONE section for the whole sandbox layer: which backend and image, the per-profile caps, where sandboxes dial back, and which credentials to seed. Switch Backend to 'kubernetes' to run this same sample against a cluster. BackendUrl/GrpcBackendUrl must be reachable FROM INSIDE the container — the host.docker.internal defaults work with AddHostGateway on Docker Desktop and Linux.

Sandbox.//creds: Optional. Point these at host paths to authenticate the in-container CLI (else the agent turn can't run). Each is mounted RO at /seed and copied into HOME by the entrypoint. e.g. ClaudeConfigHostDir=~/.claude, ClaudeConfigJsonHostFile=~/.claude.json.
